About

Four generations in gemstones — and the chart-reading to match

At Planetary Gems on Richmond Road, Dr. S. Y. Abbas carries a family trade now in its fourth generation. As an Astro Gemologist — as well as a Vedic astrologer and Vastu consultant — he brings together two things that are usually sold separately: a gemstone store, and the knowledge to tell you which stone you should actually wear.

Walk in with your date, time and place of birth, and your kundli is studied before a stone is suggested — the stone that suits your horoscope, your Rashi, your Vastu and your luck, along with its planet, weight, metal and the finger it belongs on. If you are building or moving into a home or office, the same visit can cover a Vastu consultation.

The store stocks natural, genuine precious and semi-precious stones and gemstone beads — from Ruby, Emerald and Blue Sapphire to Tiger Eye, Haqeeq and Amber, plus Navratna sets and the twelve lucky birth stones, one for every month of the year.

Lab certified stones Affordable prices 4th-generation family business

What we do

Consultation and stones, under one roof

Every recommendation starts with your chart. Dr. Abbas suggests the stone that suits your horoscope, your Rashi, your Vastu and your luck — then the store supplies it.

Vedic Astrology Consultation

A personal reading of your birth chart (kundli) by Dr. Abbas — the planets that are strong in your chart, the ones that need support, and the stone that suits your Rashi and your luck.

  • Kundli / birth-chart study
  • Which gemstone suits your chart, and which to avoid
  • Correct weight, metal and finger for wearing

Vastu Consultation

Practical Vastu guidance for homes, offices and shops — entrances, room placement and corrections that bring a space into balance.

  • Homes, flats, offices & shops
  • New construction and existing spaces
  • Simple, workable corrections

Made to order

Custom gold & silver jewellery, made by hand

A loose stone only works when it is worn right. At Planetary Gems, Dr. Abbas also makes custom gold and silver jewellery to order — so the stone your chart calls for is set in the metal, weight and design that suit you, and finished at the bench.

Bring a design of your own, a photograph of a piece you like, or just the stone — old jewellery can also be remodelled into a new piece.

  • Gemstone rings in gold or silver, set with your chart's stone and sized to the correct finger
  • Pendants & lockets for birth stones and Navagraha gems
  • Bracelets, kada & chains in gold and silver
  • Your own loose stone, set into a piece of your design
  • Old jewellery remodelled into a new design
  1. Tell us your idea — a sketch, a photo, or the stone your chart calls for
  2. Choose gold or silver, the gemstone, weight and finish
  3. Your piece is made by hand and finished, ready to wear
